# Wilcoxon - csv files, filtered genes 0 across all (ZERO filter)

# Piano BP
```{r}
# GO Biological process
gmt_file <- "https://data.broadinstitute.org/gsea-msigdb/msigdb/release/2023.2.Hs/c5.go.bp.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt" # BP
save_path <- "../results/piano_nperm10000/piano_BP/"

gmt_file <- loadGSC(gmt_file, type="gmt")

#csv_files = list(
#  "celltype" = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_vs_Expi.csv"),
#  "GPR75" = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_GPR75_vs_Expi_GPR75.csv"),
#  "GIPR" = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_GIPR_vs_Expi_GIPR.csv"),
#  "hP2X3" = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_hP2X3_vs_Expi_hP2X3.csv")
#)

csv_files = list("celltype" = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_vs_Expi.csv"))
 
x <- 1
for (csv in csv_files) {
  
  csv[csv==""] <- NA
  csv <- na.omit(csv)
  csv[,1] = toupper(csv[,1])
  log2fc <- csv$log2FoldChange
  pval <- csv$pvalue

  # Run analysis
  names(pval) <- names(log2fc) <- csv$X
  gsaRes <- runGSA(pval, directions=log2fc, geneSetStat='wilcoxon', gsc=gmt_file, nPerm=10000, ncpus = 4)
  
  # Save gsaRes!
  assign(paste0("wilcoxon_", names(csv_files[x])), gsaRes)
  
  # Save file
  save_file <- paste("piano_BP_", names(csv_files[x]), sep="")
  GSAsummaryTable(gsaRes, save=T, file=paste(save_path, save_file, ".csv", sep = ''))
  
  # Plot heatmap
  pdf(file=paste(save_path, save_file, ".pdf", sep = ''), height=6, width=8)
  GSAheatmap(gsaRes, cutoff = 5, colorkey = FALSE, ncharLabel=150, columnnames="abbr", cellnote="none", cex=0.1)
  dev.off()
  
  x <- x + 1 
}
 
```

# View piano results
```{r}

#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_BP/piano_BP_.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_BP/piano_BP_GIPR.csv", sep="\t")

#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_BP/piano_BP_hP2X3.csv", sep="\t")

df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_CC/piano_CC_.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_CC/piano_CC_GIPR.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_CC/piano_CC_GPR75.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_CC/piano_CC_hP2X3.csv", sep="\t")

#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_KEGG/piano_KEGG_.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_KEGG/piano_KEGG_GIPR.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_KEGG/piano_KEGG_GPR75.csv", sep="\t")
#df = read.csv("../results/piano_nperm1000/piano_KEGG/piano_KEGG_hP2X3.csv", sep="\t")


df <- df %>% dplyr::select(BP = Name,
                         genes = Genes..tot.,
                         padj_dn = p.adj..dist.dir.dn.,
                         padj_mix_dn = p.adj..mix.dir.dn.,
                         padj_nondir = p.adj..non.dir..,
                         padj_mix_up = p.adj..mix.dir.up.,
                         padj_up = p.adj..dist.dir.up.,)


df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(padj_dn < 0.1 | padj_mix_dn < 0.1 | padj_nondir < 0.1 | padj_mix_up < 0.1 | padj_up < 0.1)
View(df)

```
